reviewer.method: Direct reading of both complete English/Ukrainian message variants and all 90 explicit owner/context memberships in four wrapped batches (receive1-25, receive26-45, send1-20, send21-45). reviewer.guidanceExposure: Same isolated en/uk policy projection and canonical English/own corrected Ukrainian glossaries as original review. Ukrainian policy reread for closure. No Russian or other Native catalog/glossary/output used as guidance; unfiltered editorial-policy.json was not opened.

policyProjectionProvenance.method: Exact unchanged common English policy and only English plus own-locale policy entries; all foreign localePolicies omitted. The original shared policy is not modified.

reviewer.qualification: AI judgment only; no human or native-speaker qualification asserted.

scope.included: All actual Source13 schema-32968 explicit bindings: 45 app receives and 45 browser sends across 15 native callback steps, with codeA/redirectApp/stateApp memberships for each. Includes complete corrected default and every contextual override, not merely the six reported keys.
scope.excluded: Other affected schema families, other 3471 automatically added overrides, whole catalog/runtime, human/native AT/Astra/release/publication acceptance.
